queries.query: Ica Peru official cadastral parcel map registry municipal GIS API catastro
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Municipalidad Provincial de Ica/ICL cadastral modernization project, SUNARP's official BGR viewer, and official Peruvian geospatial services. No anonymous public parcel geometry endpoint with a safe stable parcel ID was verified.

queries.query: Ica Perú mapa catastral parcelas visor oficial catastro municipal SUNARP
queries.result: La búsqueda oficial confirmó que la Municipalidad Provincial de Ica y el Instituto Catastral de Lima ejecutan la actualización del catastro urbano; no se verificó un visor/API público anónimo que entregue geometría parcelaria completa y un identificador nativo seguro.

registryCustodian: Municipalidad Provincial de Ica, working with Instituto Catastral de Lima (ICL); SUNARP is the national registral custodian for its separate Base Gráfica Registral.

registryEvidence.interpretation: A local cadastral custodian and actual cadastral project/procedure are evidenced. The 2026 municipal notice reports an ICL-led urban-cadastre update, while the older municipal TUPA documents cadastral certificates and the Subgerencia de Obras Privadas y Catastro. This does not establish an open parcel API or complete city coverage.

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS-verified request timed out after 20 seconds; no page/configuration or parcel endpoint was obtained. Timeout is not evidence of cadastral absence.
HTTP 200; ArcGIS service is a cached raster imagery service in EPSG:3857, not a parcel feature service.
HTTP 200; layer 0 is a Raster Layer, confirming no parcel schema or geometry response.
HTTP 200; official Ica base-cartography service exposes points, roads, urban footprint and physical geography, with EPSG:32718 metadata, but no parcel layer.
Request timed out; official SUNARP instructions state viewer access requires DNI, issue date and CAPTCHA. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or private fields were attempted.
Official municipal notice confirms ICL/Municipalidad Provincial de Ica cadastral-system implementation and incorporation into national cartographic data; no public geometry endpoint.
Official municipal notice reports the urban-cadastre update is in progress, with 18,000 cadastral units surveyed and a first-phase target near 84,000; no public parcel download/API.
Official municipal procedure document evidences cadastral certificates and Subgerencia de Obras Privadas y Catastro; it is a procedure, not an anonymous geometry service.
